The '''Kuat Drive Yards Governor Quarters''' were the residences on board the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the governor of the Drive Yards. [[Asset K-33]] took up residence in these quarters while undercover for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
